verdict.rationale: Opting out of a product's own telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS observability platform that ships agents, a CLI and an MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to disable Datadog's own usage tracking or telemetry for its agent, CLI, MCP server or web app. Sensitive Data Scanner and Audit Trail are listed only by title and concern customer data rather than vendor telemetry, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
